profile.headline: Software Engineer Sensing & Connectivity
profile.summary:
More than 15  years of hands-on experience in Bluetooth host stack and component development, 
and technical project management within various commercial mobile phones and premium connected Car ( EQ900/G90 ).
Strong ability to identify technical needs and implement successful solutions based on Bluetooth specification. 
Growing knowledge of Bluetooth related new technologies to effectively support projects. 
Involving various Interoperability activity with SIG and Car-Kit vendor. 
Highly resourceful and self motivated team player with the ability to effectively solve problems.

positions.title: Sr Engineer
positions.description:
Bluetooth S/W Engineer 
● Bluetooth S/W developer for LX350, LX550, MX800, Optimus G handset.
● Lead Developer of NFC/Bluetooth Connection Handover   
● Participated of LG Bluetooth Host stack qualification ( Core 3.0 )
● Participated interoperability activities 
     - Bluetooth Unplugfest 
     - Bluetooth CE4A 
     - Bluetooth standard requirements of LG
